desc:
FLAT PvP — Minecraft 1.8 Style PvP on Roblox

If you like Minecraft 1.8 PvP, give this game a try.

- Fight players and take their materials
- Smelt your loot to make it more valuable
- Sell resources and spend them in the shop
- Survive as the world resets every 60 minutes
- Play the new **Duels** modes: Sumo, Classic, and TNT

Every fight gives you something to work toward, whether you're grinding resources or just looking for a fight.

The game is still in alpha, so expect updates, new features, and improvements along the way.

Got ideas or feedback? Join the Discord and help shape the game.

This is my first Roblox game, so I'd really appreciate you checking it out and letting me know what you think.

Disclaimer: No assets are taken from Minecraft or Mojang.
